promises.quote: We are going to amend our inpatient falls policy. This will help us to ensure that post incident monitoring is undertaken. It will also more clearly link our standards in ED and on the wards. It is unacceptable that in this situation the requested monitoring was discontinued. Our use of Vital Pac and the upcoming installation of our new electronic patient record by Christmas 2017 will provide decision support and alerts to reinforce our standards. These changes will be complete by the end of March
promises.summary: Amend inpatient falls policy to improve post-incident monitoring and link ED/ward standards
